GENERAL.TITLE: General Settings
GENERAL.SUBTITLE: Manage the settings that apply to all your site languages.
GENERAL.AUTO_SWITCH_DESC: Automatically show your site to visitors in their browser language. (Not recommended for SEO)
GENERAL.AUTO_SWITCH_WARN: Activating language auto-switch is not recommended for search engines and will harm your site's SEO.
GENERAL.DEFAULT_LANG_DESC: This is the first language visitors see when they arrive on your site. It can be different than the original language.
GENERAL.URL_STRUCTURE_DESC: This is how visitors and search engines see your site's address in languages.
GENERAL.URL_NOTE: Remember, it can take some time for search engines to recognize the changes you make to your site's URL structure.
GENERAL.DIRECTION_DESC: Set the reading direction for each language. Right-to-left languages (Arabic, Persian…) flip the site layout.
